message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 (C allele) in Europeans**

| Source | Population | Allele frequency (C) |
|--------|------------|-----------------------|
| gnomAD v2.1 (EUR) | European (non-Finnish) | **≈ 0.12 (12 %)** |
| 1000 Genomes Phase 3 | CEU (Utah residents with Northern/Western European ancestry) | ≈ 0.11 (11 %) |
| 1000 Genomes Phase 3 | TSI (Toscani in Italy) | ≈ 0.13 (13 %) |

> **Interpretation:**  
> The C allele at rs7412 defines the ε2 allele of APOE. In most European cohorts it occurs in roughly 10–13 % of chromosomes, corresponding to an ε2 carrier rate of ~5–7 % (since ε2 is usually heterozygous).

> **Notes & caveats**  
> * The exact frequency can vary slightly between sub‑European populations (e.g., higher in Southern Europeans).  
> * These figures come from large public datasets (gnomAD and 1000 Genomes); they represent the general European population rather than specific subgroups.  

If you need more precise numbers for a particular country or study cohort, let me know!
